assistantActionUnavailable: This action is no longer available here. Check the current task or configuration.
assistantActivityHint: Message acceptance and a finished assistant turn do not mean the objective is complete. Check its evidence above.
assistantCapabilitiesHint: This directory describes current configuration and attachments. Listed tools still require their normal authorization.
assistantConflict: This item changed. Refresh its current state before trying again.
assistantCredentialsHint: Metadata checks only. Secret values are not loaded here, and account access may still need confirmation in the worker.
assistantDisabled: Enable the Orchestrator in Settings → System → Feature Toggles to use this page.
assistantForgetHint: Edits and forgetting affect future context. They cannot remove text already delivered to a provider or kept in history and backups.
assistantMemorySafety: Store preferences and constraints here. Keep passwords and secret values in your credential manager.
assistantModeHint_answer: Answer using available context. No worker changes.
assistantModeHint_design: Delegate design work through normal workflow and approval gates.
assistantModeHint_execute: Delegate implementation through normal workflow and approval gates.
assistantModeHint_inspect: Inspect scoped information without changing worker tasks.
assistantOutcomeUnknown: The result could not be confirmed. Check the current state before repeating the action.
assistantPaused: Assistant paused. Existing workers keep running.
assistantProfileUnavailable: This execution profile cannot currently run the assistant. Review its provider, account and executor settings.
assistantSetupHint: Select an existing orchestrator for your private conversation. Its execution profile determines the account it uses.
assistantSourceExcerpt: Showing an excerpt of the original instruction.
assistantStopContinue: Stop the next page of managed work
assistantStopHint: Stop the currently managed worker sessions. Each session reports its own result. History is preserved and external changes are not undone.
assistantStopPartial: Some sessions could not be confirmed stopped. Review their results below.
assistantStopReported: Cancellation results for this page of managed work:
assistantUnavailable: Could not refresh this view. Check your connection and try again.
completeKanbanFirst: Complete Kanban setup and configure your agent profiles first
conversationUnavailable: The conversation is unavailable. Check the coordinator configuration and try again.
coordinatedTasksHint: The latest 100 tasks owned by this orchestrator. Open a task to manage its agent, workflow and execution.
coordinatorHint: Chat with the Orchestrator while workspace task state stays beside it.
deleteOrchestratorHint: Remove this coordinator and stop its sessions. Delivery tasks remain on the board.
knownTaskTotals: Loaded tasks: {{open}} open pull requests (known for {{prKnown}}/{{tasks}}); {{files}} changed files (known for {{gitKnown}}/{{tasks}}).
maintenanceArtifactHint: Review this patch and the check results before applying it. The original checkout and running services have not been changed by this repair.
maintenanceArtifactUnavailable: The local artifact is unavailable or cannot be verified.
maintenanceAskAssistant: Ask the assistant to prepare the approved files for this proposal. The repair task uses only the scoped repair tools.
maintenanceEvidenceHint: Only typed native event metadata is retained. Evidence expires after 30 days; review receipts remain.
maintenanceExecuteRequired: Use Execute mode with an available assistant profile to prepare this repair.
maintenanceFiles: Exact file paths, one per line
maintenanceGrantHint: Allow the assistant to read and edit these files, run the fixed checks, and prepare a local commit. Publishing or changing running services requires a separate decision.
maintenanceGrantInactive: Preparation grant is inactive or has changed
maintenanceInvalidGrant: Choose every resource, list 1–32 unique files, and provide both commands as JSON arrays of arguments. The duration must be 1–168 hours.
maintenanceNoCommit: No committed patch is available yet.
maintenanceNoSuccess: No qualifying successful workflow has been observed yet.
maintenancePolicyUnknown: The policy or classifier version is unknown.
maintenanceResolutionHint: A prepared patch does not prove recovery. Select a later successful affected task with a persisted result and completed native reviews. Kandev checks the evidence again when you confirm.
maintenanceSandboxHint: Checks can read the entire committed repository in an offline, read-only Docker container. Use an image already installed locally and checks that need no network or repository writes.
maintenanceThreshold: A proposal appears after three matching incidents across two tasks within seven days. Repeated requests do not grant permission to bypass a gate.
maintenanceUnknown: An operation was interrupted or its result could not be confirmed. Inspect the artifact before continuing. Recovery records a verified existing commit and does not repeat the operation.
name: Name
noCoordinatedTasks: No tasks yet. Open the conversation to delegate work or ask the orchestrator to adopt an existing task.
noLoadedMatches: No matches in the loaded tasks. More pages may contain matches.
noOrchestrators: No orchestrators yet. Add one to coordinate this workspace.
orchestrationEnable: Enable the experimental feature in System settings.
orchestratorProfileHint: This profile runs the coordinator. Delivery tasks use their own profiles, which you can change independently.
orchestratorsHint: Add a global role to this workspace, choose the agent that runs it and provide workspace context. Each assignment has its own conversation and tasks.
partialCoverage: Counts describe loaded tasks. Load more to include remaining matches.
personaExecutorProfileHint: Pin this persona to a configured local or SSH profile. Worker profiles choose where their account and tools run.
profileUnavailable: The selected agent profile or execution environment is unavailable. Update this coordinator’s configuration to continue.
roleAssignmentHint: Name, icon and instructions come from the global role. Role changes apply to every workspace using it on the next turn.
rolesHint: Configure each role once: its name, icon and instructions. Workspaces choose the agent profile, execution environment and local context. Saved role changes apply to all assignments on their next turn.
selectCoordinatorHint: Choose a coordinator to open its conversation.
selectionUnavailable: That coordinator is unavailable in this workspace. Choose an assignment or check its configuration.
staleTasks: Task data may be out of date. Refresh to try again.
workspaceUnavailable: This workspace could not be loaded. Check your access and try again.
workspaceLinkHint: Linking shares the workspace name and the selected fields with this profile. Workers keep their own accounts. Account changes require reconfirmation.
workspaceCoordinate: Allow task coordination through native workflow and approval gates
workspaceExport_directory: Workflow, repository and profile names and routing IDs
workspaceExport_task_summary: Task titles, states and attention references
workspaceExport_task_input: Current task questions and permission requests
workspaceExport_handoff: Scoped task handoffs with the owner request and shared preferences
workspaceConfirmReceiver: I confirm this workspace context may be sent to the displayed profile.
workspaceHistoryLimit: Revoking blocks new access; text already in chat or sent to a provider remains. Forgetting deletes saved handoff packets and invalidates queued references. Native tasks and audit receipts remain.
workspaceChangeFailed: Access changed or the request failed. Refresh and review the current scope before retrying.
workspaceAuditHint: Metadata records possible delivery to a profile. They contain no prompt bodies and remain after revocation or forgetting.
